review: Independent read-only startup/UI acquisition and integration review
verdict: No concrete Critical or Important regressions found in the reviewed snapshot.

new_scene_setup_fix.assessment: The internal ownership gap is closed for failures after renderer acquisition and after controls construction. Cleanup attempts are independent and preserve the original setup error.

source_evidence.detail: Controls handle remains available to the failure handler after construction.
Separate guarded controls and renderer disposal attempts precede rethrowing the original error.
Successful scene setup immediately transfers renderer and controls to the runtime owner.

tests_read: src/frontend/app/sceneSetup.test.ts: failed scene setup retains acquisition ownership (two pixel-ratio variants and controls configuration failure)
src/frontend/app/runtimeLifetime.test.ts: throwing disposer and diagnostic reporter containment

independent_probe.method: bounded fault probe; renderer double plus real OrbitControls; actual extracted createSceneSetup
cases: Pixel-ratio failure with successful or throwing renderer disposal.
Controls configuration failure with every combination of successful or throwing controls and renderer disposal.
Healthy construction transfers ownership without premature disposal.
verified: Removal of real controls canvas/document listeners
independent_probe.limit: Uses a renderer double; does not exercise native GPU disposal.

requirement_review.requirement: One catalog-or-procedural asteroid population and renderer; early catalog fetch
requirement_review.assessment: Supported by source trace: transport starts before textures and scene assembly, source selection precedes the single population and renderer allocation.

requirement_review.requirement: 50k asteroids, 5k Kuiper objects, checksum validation and 2-second load budget
requirement_review.assessment: Main retains the population counts and existing loader budget parameter. The loader still hashes the binary and evaluates acceptance over its original fetch-to-parse/hash clock; no full-scene startup timing claim is inferred.

Pending cancellation rejects without allocating fallback resources; cancellation is rechecked around allocation and scale application. Main registers the returned renderer before its post-await liveness check and synchronizes scale from the checkbox.

requirement_review.requirement: Runtime acquisition cleanup including quadtree, Sun, worker and listeners
requirement_review.assessment: Ownership is registered as resources are acquired. Disposal aborts first, retires callbacks in reverse order and contains callback/reporting errors. Main registers quadtree and Sun teardown, worker termination, observer disconnection, frame disposal and event-listener cancellation.

requirement_review.requirement: Immediate keyboard camera feedback independent of RAF
requirement_review.assessment: Actions flush in a microtask and publish Range through onActionApplied; disposal clears pending input. Main supplies updateZoomStatus to that callback.

requirement_review.requirement: Native zoom width-based modality and focus
requirement_review.assessment: Both production and shell callers supply innerWidth-based layout state. Resize, visual viewport and media-query signals reconcile that state, with a next-task width recheck and disposal cancellation. Existing focus transition ordering and modal trap remain in place.

Unload closes the runtime owner; catalog adoption and shader-warmup continuations check cancellation, frame disposal removes visibility listeners and prevents restart, and worker callbacks reject retired ownership. This is a static ownership trace, not a new browser-run claim.

verification_limits: No broad unit suite, browser matrix, build, DEV cold-start or PREVIEW cold-start was run in this independent review.
Parent/worker-reported test counts were not independently rerun or treated as completion evidence.
Native browser zoom and actual GPU cleanup were reviewed through source and test changes, not independently executed.
The shared worktree was not frozen; the recorded file hashes bind this review to the bytes inspected at completion.
Simulation subscription and backend/science remediation outside the requested startup/UI scope were not reviewed.
